easyPrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha.
Resolve the Lyse trigger, giving it +1/+1 counter on it.
When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.
